name: scroll-mask-wipe
title: Scroll Mask Wipe
description: A headline wiped open by the page's own scroll position: an inset clip-path tied to viewport progress means the reader, not a timer, controls how much of the statement is visible.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Scroll Progress: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
